resource: Talk range of an NPC conversation (Chebyshev distance, same floor)
allocation_impact: A customer beyond 4 tiles, or on another floor, has the conversation closed on every committed move of the customer or the NPC. CHAT0-RL-08 reads this limit.
boundary_tests: max=4: a customer at distance 4 stays in conversation
max+1=5: a customer at distance 5 has the conversation closed
notes: NPC-BEHAVIOUR-0 §7; value fixed by the amendment of NPC-0 §4.1. Registered by OTV2-20261005-npc-wire-1 (NPC-WIRE-1).
